meta.description: Machine-readable snapshot of per-corridor payment-instruction requirements for Borderless withdrawals. Mirrors the 'Payment instruction details by corridor' table in .claude/skills/borderless-withdrawal-flow/SKILL.md — update both together.
meta.authority: This file is a working snapshot drawn from observed integration behavior. Live discovery is ALWAYS authoritative: GET /organizations/network?status=active for capability, GET /withdrawals/institutions for the institutionIdentifier field, and the PFI's async pfiErrorMessage for anything missed. See cookbook/discovery.md.
meta.amountDenomination: The withdrawal `amount` is denominated in the SOURCE asset (e.g. USDC), not destination fiat. perTransactionCap values below are expressed in the currency stated — convert before comparing.

scopeValues.provider-dependent: Applies wherever the observed PFI routes the corridor
scopeValues.org-dependent: Observed on some orgs, not others — re-verify on yours

dtoVariants.BankDetailsCreateDto: Most corridors — bankSlug, bankAccountNumber, optionally localRoutingCode

corridors.notes: bankAccountType is Checking or Savings.
bankAccountType (Checking | Savings) has been observed as required for Wire, same as ACH — omitting it 422s. Treat the Wire and ACH shapes as identical unless discovery says otherwise.
Some orgs validate bankAccountNumber as a UK IBAN (GB29...) — if a plain 8-digit account number is rejected with an IBAN-regex message, switch to IBAN format.

bankAccountNumber must hold the FULL IBAN. A bare account number passes PI creation but fails async. SEPA may require org-level enablement — see providers/bridge.md. A PI is stored per (currency, country, method) independent of PFI — the same SEPA shape has been reused across PFIs without a per-PFI variant; try an existing PI before creating a new one and branch shapes only on an actual 422.
identifierType: Email | CPF | CNPJ | PhoneNumber | EVP. address is deprecated for PIX.

bankAccountNumber is the exact 22-digit CBU/CVU. bankAccountNumberType: CBU | CVU | ALIAS. Some PFIs validate the identity's CUIT (mod-11) and require address.country == AR — see providers/koywe.md. Discovery may return institutionIdentifier: bankName on some orgs. Transfers30 is a sibling AR method with the same PI shape (see the AR/Transfers30 entry).

Use whichever institutionIdentifier discovery returns — bankCode on some PFIs, bankSlug on others. Some PFIs require address.country == CO. CO/ACH and CO/Bre-B are separate methods with their own entries.
Key-only corridor.

The 18-digit CLABE goes in bankAccountNumber. Asset support varies by active provider — validate via organizations/network (see cookbook/discovery.md). Some PFIs require a bankSlug (allInstitutionsSupported:false); others accept the CLABE alone — check discovery.
Slugs are PFI-specific — re-discover after any routing change. BankTransfer and NIP are distinct methods on NGN (each needs its own PI); this entry is BankTransfer. See the NG/NIP entry.
One of the few corridors where the iban field name is correct.
IBAN-only shape like AE/NPSS, plus bankSlug.

perTransactionCap.note: amount is in source asset — the USDC ceiling moves with FX; compute 100000 / live exchangeRate rather than hardcoding a USDC figure

corridors.notes: bankAccountNumber holds the Turkish IBAN. bankSlug required (allInstitutionsSupported:false). The 100,000 TRY cap converts to a source-asset ceiling that changes with the rate — recompute per quote.

localRoutingCode holds the IFSC; accepted on creation but not echoed in GET. Invoice on the withdrawal call is an Indian regulatory requirement (FIRC) — the invoice image must be at least 200x200px, or the withdrawal 422s with a documents-dimensions error.
For e-wallets (GCash), bankAccountNumber is the phone number; discover the wallet's slug.
Method is EFT, not BankTransfer.
IBAN format PK36ABPL... The iban-only shape still needs a bankSlug (hybrid) — sending bankName/accountHolderName/bankAccountNumber 422s at PI creation.
localRoutingCode holds the transit number (XXX-XXXXX or XXXXX-XXX).

localRoutingCode holds the 6-digit BSB. Some PFIs validate the SENDER identity's own address.postalCode against the AU 4-digit format at account creation — this surfaces async (path identity.address.postalCode), not at PI creation, and needs a sender identity whose postal code matches. See cookbook/error-catalog.md.

4-digit bank + 3-digit branch. bankSlug selects from the institution list; bankCode (the numeric bank code) is a separate field the PFI requires but the API does not validate synchronously — omitting bankCode passes PI creation but fails async ('Missing required fields: bank.bankCode'). Trust institutionIdentifier from discovery for the identifier field name.

Standard slug-based corridors. Per-transaction caps vary by route and provider and are best read from the live quote's limits.transaction (e.g. TH/THB has been observed with a tight ~49,999 THB cap while most others cap in the millions or are effectively uncapped).

Sibling AR local rail to COELSA — same PI shape, and observed bankSlug-less (allInstitutionsSupported:true) on some orgs. bankAccountNumber is the 22-digit CBU/CVU; bankAccountNumberType: CBU | CVU | ALIAS.

Distinct from BR/PIX (which is identifier-based). TED needs both a bankSlug (from institutions) and localRoutingCode holding the bank branch/agencia code. Omitting localRoutingCode passes PI creation but fails async ('Missing required fields: bank.branchCode') — set it at creation.

bankSlug required (allInstitutionsSupported:false). Slugs are PFI-specific — discover with /withdrawals/institutions?...&pfiName={routing PFI}; reusing a slug stored from another PFI is rejected at submission.

Institution identifier is bankCode (a numeric code), not bankSlug — confirm via the institutionIdentifier hint on the institutions response. allInstitutionsSupported:true observed (no list to pick from).
Institution identifier is bankCode, not bankSlug (per the institutionIdentifier hint).
Institution identifier is bankCode, not bankSlug (per the institutionIdentifier hint).

NIP is a distinct paymentMethod from NG/BankTransfer — the two are not aliases and each needs its own payment instruction (the method value alone forces a separate PI). bankSlug is PFI-specific; discover per routing PFI.

localRoutingCode holds the 12-digit CNAPS code; institutionIdentifier is localRoutingCode with an empty supportedInstitutions list (no bankSlug to pick). Invoice required on the withdrawal call (see invoiceRequiredCountries).

Gulf/Levant iban-plus-bankSlug shape (like PK/IBFT). SA/MADA settles bank-transfer style despite the card-network name — do not infer PI shape from the method-enum name. Discover bankSlug per routing PFI.

Costa Rica's dollarized SINPE leg can quote as available, but PI creation currently enforces a country/currency whitelist (CR maps to CRC) while SINPE maps only to country CR — no (country, currency) pairing satisfies both validators together, so the route is not creatable end-to-end today. Confirm status with support@borderless.xyz before building.

Institution identifier is networkSlug (not bankSlug) — discover it at runtime and don't assume the field name. bankAccountNumber and address are rejected ('should not exist'). phone must be a string in full international format (>=7 chars); some PFIs require the leading + country-code prefix and fail async without it (a missing + does not 422 at PI creation). A discovered network can still be rejected by the underlying rail — if a withdrawal fails with an invalid-operator/network error, retry with a different network from the same list.

invoiceRequiredCountries.behavior: Omitting documents does not 422 — the withdrawal submits, then fails async with 'please upload an invoice…'. Pass documents: [{type: 'Invoice', content: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,...'}] on POST /withdrawals. JPEG/PNG/PDF, min 200x200, max 5MB.
